reviewRole: Independent final deployment/catalog reviewer: neither implemented these three deployment files nor authored the frozen catalog suites
verifiedBoundaries: New publication requires exactly the canonical V1..V16 SQL names, in numeric order; extra entries, missing files, alternate names and source symlinks fail closed.
V1..V15 raw bytes match the independently pinned approved PR inventory; V16 exists as actual SQL, not the synthetic RED fallback.
Schema fingerprint uses ordered version/script/raw SHA256 catalog; guard and archive fingerprints and Flyway checksums remain bound.
Manifest and host record readers accept exactly six historical complete inventories plus final contiguous16. Unpublished complete13/14/15 catalogs remain denied.
Observed successful history must match the exact row/checksum/order prefix of the target release even with explicit first-transition approval.
Sparse historical107/110 histories are readable but cannot be silently converted into a contiguous16 target prefix, including when explicit approval is true.

Automatic readiness still requires full history and matching schema/guard fingerprints and trusted READY host state. Manual transition still requires explicit approval, both refresh rules DISABLED and no pending commands.
Failed rows, changed checksums, reordered history, CI/source identity mismatch and stale fingerprints remain fail closed.
limits: This review does not approve operational deployment, real DB migration, main merge, provider execution, or infrastructure changes.
Sparse histories intentionally require a separate operator-reviewed migration strategy; an approval flag is not such a strategy.
V16 business-schema and PostgreSQL behavior are owned by the migration/application review and tests, not inferred from publication inventory checks.
